cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title:
PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient
pagination. Ex:

count_total.description:
count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include
a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs.
count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key
is set.

key.description:
key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin
querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key
should be set.

limit.description:
limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page.
If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

offset.description:
offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable.
It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should
be set.

reverse.description:
reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

Since: cosmos-sdk 0.43

next_key.description:
next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to
query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if
there are no more results.

total.title:
total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total
was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.v1beta1.Coin.description:
Coin defines a token with a denomination and an amount.

NOTE: The amount field is an Int which implements the custom method
signatures required by gogoproto.

lucidchain.proto.attestor.v1.Attestation.description:
Attestation is a signed claim by a registered attestor about a specific
sidechain checkpoint (or, more generally, a specific on-chain reference).

checkpoint_sequence.title: the x/checkpoint sequence this attestation is about

claim_payload.description:
Structured claim payload (schema-specific fields), encoded as JSON per the
schema's documented format. Kept off the hot path of consensus-critical logic --
the module treats this as an opaque, size-limited blob.

id.title: deterministic: hash of (schema_id, sidechain_id, sequence, attestor_id)

lucidchain.proto.attestor.v1.Attestation.description:
AttestationSchema defines the shape and scope of a claim attestors can make.
Published via governance so the exact wording of a claim -- and what it
deliberately does NOT cover -- is fixed and auditable, not ad hoc per attestation.

active.title: governance can retire a schema without deleting history

claim_description.description: Precise, narrow description of what a valid attestation under this schema asserts.

dispute_window_seconds.description: Dispute window during which an ATTESTATION_STATUS_ACTIVE attestation can be challenged.

exclusions.description:
Explicit statement of what is NOT covered (e.g. "does not verify underlying
transaction authenticity, only that reported figures match submitted source data").

required_data_sources.description:
Data sources an attestor must consult per this schema (informational/off-chain process,
documented here for auditability).

validity_period_seconds.description: How long an attestation under this schema remains valid before it must be renewed.

lucidchain.proto.attestor.v1.Attestation.description:
AttestationStatus tracks the dispute lifecycle of a single attestation.

 - ATTESTATION_STATUS_ACTIVE: published, within or past dispute window, standing
 - ATTESTATION_STATUS_DISPUTED: a dispute has been raised, within dispute window
 - ATTESTATION_STATUS_UPHELD: dispute resolved in the attestor's favor
 - ATTESTATION_STATUS_OVERTURNED: dispute resolved against the attestor; may trigger slashing
 - ATTESTATION_STATUS_REVOKED: attestor voluntarily revoked (e.g. credential expired)

lucidchain.proto.attestor.v1.Attestor.description:
Attestor is the on-chain registration record for a qualified attesting entity
(e.g. a certification body, auditor, or regulator).

authorized_schema_ids.description:
Domains this attestor is qualified to attest in, referencing published
AttestationSchema ids (e.g. "hospitality.revenue-report.v1").

credential_uri.description: URI to off-chain credentials/accreditation evidence for this attestor.

operator.title: bech32 address controlling this attestor's on-chain actions

reputation_score.description:
Simple reputation counter: successful attestations minus overturned ones.
Informational only -- not consensus-critical, not used in signature checks.

lucidchain.proto.attestor.v1.AttestorSta.description:
AttestorStatus defines the lifecycle state of a registered attestor.

 - ATTESTOR_STATUS_PENDING: registered, bond posted, awaiting activation
 - ATTESTOR_STATUS_ACTIVE: eligible to submit attestations
 - ATTESTOR_STATUS_SUSPENDED: temporarily barred (e.g. open dispute)
 - ATTESTOR_STATUS_SLASHED: bond slashed for a provable fault
 - ATTESTOR_STATUS_EXITED: voluntarily deregistered

lucidchain.proto.attestor.v1.Dispute.description: Dispute is raised against an Attestation within its schema's dispute window.

bond_amount.title: challenger's bond, returned + rewarded if upheld, forfeited if not

challenger.title: bech32 address of the party raising the dispute

upheld.title: true if the dispute succeeded (attestation overturned)

lucidchain.proto.attestor.v1.Params.description: Params defines module-wide parameters, settable via governance.

dispute_resolver_authority.description:
Governance/arbiter mechanism resolves disputes; this is the account (e.g.
gov module) authorized to call ResolveDispute. A future version may replace
this with a dedicated arbitration module.

lucidchain.proto.checkpoint.v1.Checkpoin.description:
Checkpoint is a finalized commitment submitted by a registered sidechain.
It stores only cryptographic commitments -- never raw application data.

checkpoint_hash.description: SHA-256 over the sign bytes of CheckpointSignDoc (see below).

data_pointer.description: Optional off-chain pointer (IPFS CID, URI). Covered by the signatures, not verified on-chain.

previous_checkpoint_hash.description:
Hash of the immediately preceding checkpoint for this sidechain,
forming a verifiable chain. Empty for sequence == 1.

record_count.description:
Number of individual records/events committed in this batch.
Informational; used for fee calculation and monitoring, not consensus-critical.

sequence.description:
Monotonically increasing sequence number for this sidechain's checkpoints.
Must equal the previous checkpoint's sequence + 1 (no gaps, no reordering).

sidechain_id.description: ID of the sidechain this checkpoint belongs to (see x/sidechain.Sidechain.id).

signatures_digest.description:
SHA-256 of the concatenation of the verified signatures, ordered by
signer_index. Lets an auditor holding the original signatures prove they
are the ones the chain accepted, without storing ~3.3 KB per signer.

signer_bitmap.description:
Bit i set => the key at Sidechain.signer_keys[i] (at signer_set_version)
produced a valid signature. Length = ceil(len(signer_keys) / 8).

signer_set_version.description: Sidechain.signer_set_version under which this checkpoint was verified.

state_root.description:
Merkle root (or equivalent state commitment) of the batch of records
this checkpoint covers, as computed off-chain by the sidechain.

lucidchain.proto.checkpoint.v1.Params.description: Params defines module-wide parameters, settable via governance.

base_fee.description: Base fee per checkpoint submission, in the native token's smallest denom.

max_data_pointer_bytes.description: Maximum size in bytes of the data_pointer field.

max_records_per_checkpoint.description: Maximum record_count allowed to be declared in a single checkpoint.

max_signature_bytes_per_checkpoint.description:
Upper bound on total signature bytes in one message. With ML-DSA-65
(3309 B/sig), 7 signatures is ~23 KB; size this together with the block
max_bytes consensus param and charge gas per signature verified.

max_signatures_per_checkpoint.description: Upper bound on signatures in one message.

per_record_fee.description: Additional fee per record in the batch (record_count), to price large batches fairly.

lucidchain.proto.proofs.v1.Params.description: Params defines module-wide parameters, settable via governance.

base_verification_fee.description:
Base fee for proof verification. Actual cost varies significantly by
proof system, so this is a floor; per-system fee multipliers are held
alongside each VerifierRegistration in a future revision if needed.

lucidchain.proto.proofs.v1.ProofRecord.description:
ProofRecord is a finalized, on-chain-verified validity proof about a
specific checkpoint (or a specific claim scoped to that checkpoint).

claim_id.description:
Identifies which specific, narrow claim this proof establishes (e.g.
"geofence-compliance", "aml-threshold-not-exceeded"), analogous to a
schema_id in x/attestor. Claim semantics are defined off-chain in the
circuit's public documentation, referenced here by id for traceability.

id.title: deterministic: hash of (sidechain_id, checkpoint_sequence, proof_system_id, claim_id)

proof.description: The proof itself, in the encoding expected by the registered verifier.

public_inputs.description:
Public inputs the proof was checked against (circuit-specific encoding).
Must include, at minimum, a binding to state_root of the referenced
checkpoint so the proof cannot be replayed against an unrelated one.

verified.title: always true for persisted records; verification happens

verified_height.title:
synchronously in the message handler and failed proofs
are rejected, not stored

lucidchain.proto.proofs.v1.VerifierRegis.description:
VerifierRegistration describes a pluggable proof-system verifier available
to sidechains at Tier 3. Concrete verification logic lives in Go code
(see keeper interface, section below) -- this record is the on-chain,
governance-controlled pointer to it, plus its verification key material.

proof_system_id.description:
e.g. "groth16-bn254", "plonk-bls12-381", "risc0-v1". Must match a
verifier implementation compiled into the chain binary (see ADR in
section 4 of the accompanying spec).

verification_key.description:
Verification key / circuit-specific parameters, opaque to this module,
interpreted only by the corresponding Go verifier implementation.

version.description:
Governance-controlled version, incremented if verification_key rotates
(e.g. circuit upgrade). Proofs record which version they were checked against.

lucidchain.proto.proofs.v1.VerifierStatu.description:
VerifierStatus tracks whether a registered proof-system verifier is usable.

 - VERIFIER_STATUS_DEPRECATED: no longer accepting new proofs, existing ones still queryable

lucidchain.proto.sidechain.v1.AssuranceT.description:
AssuranceTier defines the level of validation a sidechain has registered for.

 - ASSURANCE_TIER_NOTARIZED: Tier 1: timestamped commitment only
 - ASSURANCE_TIER_ATTESTED: Tier 2: notarized + attestor sign-off
 - ASSURANCE_TIER_PROVEN: Tier 3: notarized + validity proof verification

lucidchain.proto.sidechain.v1.Params.description: Params defines module-wide parameters, settable via governance.

allowed_pubkey_type_urls.description:
Protobuf type URLs of public keys accepted as checkpoint signers, e.g.
"/cosmos.crypto.mldsa65.PubKey". For a quantum-resistant deployment set this
to ML-DSA-65 only; adding classical types (ed25519, secp256k1) re-opens the
sidechain to quantum forgery of its checkpoint signatures.

max_signer_keys.description:
Maximum signer keys per sidechain. ML-DSA-65 pubkeys are 1952 bytes each,
so this directly bounds per-sidechain state size.

min_bond_by_tier.description: One entry per tier; Validate() rejects duplicates and UNSPECIFIED.

lucidchain.proto.sidechain.v1.Sidechain.description: Sidechain is the on-chain registration record for a private sidechain.

bond.description: Bond posted at registration (amount and denom).

checkpoint_interval_seconds.description: Expected interval between checkpoints, in seconds.

last_checkpoint_sequence.description:
Owned by x/sidechain; updated by x/checkpoint via the expected-keeper call
RecordCheckpoint. Zero / empty until the first checkpoint is accepted.

name.description: Human-readable name, shown in explorers and dashboards.

operator.description: Bech32 address of the sidechain operator (registration owner, admin actions).

signature_threshold.description: Minimum number of distinct signers required per checkpoint.

signer_keys.description:
Keys authorized to sign checkpoints, as SDK public keys. Post-quantum
deployments use /cosmos.crypto.mldsa65.PubKey (ML-DSA-65, FIPS 204).
Allowed type URLs are restricted by Params.allowed_pubkey_type_urls.
Order is significant: Signature.signer_index refers to a position in this list.

signer_set_version.description:
Incremented on every change to signer_keys or signature_threshold.
Checkpoints record the version they were signed under, so signer indices
stay unambiguous across rotations.

lucidchain.proto.sidechain.v1.SidechainS.description:
SidechainStatus defines the lifecycle state of a registered sidechain.

 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_PENDING: registered, bond posted, awaiting activation
 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_ACTIVE: accepting checkpoints
 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_SUSPENDED: temporarily halted (e.g. missed interval, dispute)
 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_SLASHED: bond slashed for a provable fault
 - SIDECHAIN_STATUS_EXITED: voluntarily deregistered, bond returned after cooldown

lucidchain.proto.sidechain.v1.TierBond.description: TierBond is the minimum bond for one assurance tier.
